limitations: Different realized holdings and cash paths can change risk,not just fees
Small direct fee saving counterevidence retained
Daily source-vintage/calendar/right and ex-date-credit assumptions unchanged
lesson: Monthly discretionary buy-topups modestly reduce fees and drawdown but do not meet10%Calmar or no-lower-growth guards. No-topup control improves headline Calmar less than1% while sacrificing CAGR. Cost-saving engineering is not sufficient alpha; incumbent unchanged. Exclusive-create protected C05 receipt after a driver naming error; read-only recovery added no financial launches.
frozen_driver_limitation: Postseal export still names C05 file in frozen C06 source. Do not rerun or claim it repaired; preserve source identity. Historical bundle and closing receipt recovered separately.
